responsibility: Implements C-family UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer instrumentation helpers that operate on front-end trees before or during lowering. It builds checks for division overflow, shift errors, VLA bounds, array bounds, null/alignment/reference misuse, and member-call/reference validation, producing runtime helper calls or traps and integrating with sanitizer flags and internal functions used later in GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: Defines the C-family UBSan implementation logic: it builds the actual tree-based checks and runtime or trap calls for division, shifts, bounds, references, and member calls, whereas c-ubsan.h only declares those instrumentation entry points for other front-end code to use.
